SELECT t1.*, t1.last_update_date AS judge_time, (SELECT fe.name FROM fnd_employee fe WHERE fe.employee_code = t1.judge_member_code AND fe.company_id = #{request.companyId}) NAME, (SELECT fop.position_name FROM fnd_org_position fop, fnd_employee fe, fnd_employee_assigns fea WHERE fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fea.position_id = fop.position_id AND fe.employee_code = t1.judge_member_code AND fe.company_id = #{request.companyId} AND fea.position_id = (SELECT MAX(p.position_id) FROM fnd_employee_assigns p WHERE p.employee_id = fe.employee_id)) position_name, (SELECT DISTINCT fou.unit_name FROM fnd_org_unit fou, fnd_employee_assigns fea, fnd_employee fe WHERE fou.unit_id = fea.unit_id AND fe.employee_id = fea.employee_id AND fe.employee_code = t1.judge_member_code AND fe.company_id = #{request.companyId} AND fea.unit_id = (SELECT MAX(p.unit_id) FROM fnd_employee_assigns p WHERE p.employee_id = fe.employee_id)) unit_name, (SELECT fcb.company_short_name FROM fnd_company fcb, fnd_employee fe WHERE fe.company_id = fcb.company_id AND fe.employee_code = t1.judge_member_code AND fe.company_id = #{request.companyId}) company_short_name FROM act_meeting_judge t1 WHERE 1 = 1
and t1.process_instance_id = #{processInstanceId}
